text:
jay: FYI customer reporting intermittent 500s + huge tail latency on /v1/generate. They gave req-id `0a1b2c3d4e` and region eu-west-1. Need a very small repro bundle (py/js/go + curl) we can hand off to infra. Also need request logs + traces.

oliver: Can you paste the exact prompt and the full request headers they used? do we have SDK version?

jay: Prompt: 'Summarize quarterly earnings in 3 bullets'. Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>`, `X-Request-ID: 0a1b2c3d4e`, SDK: python 0.9.3. Customer says it happens ~10% of requests at ~1200 tokens.

maria: I'll draft tiny repros. Keep them minimal so they reproduce the same path (streaming vs non-streaming).

maria: Python snippet (sync REST curl-like):
```python
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer REDACTED", "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Request-ID": "0a1b2c3d4e"}
payload = {"model": "open-8b", "input": "Summarize quarterly earnings in 3 bullets", "max_tokens": 1200}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
print(resp.status_code)
print(resp.headers.get('X-Request-ID'))
print(resp.text[:1000])
```

maria: Node (minimal):
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer REDACTED', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Request-ID': '0a1b2c3d4e' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'open-8b', input: 'Summarize quarterly earnings in 3 bullets', max_tokens: 1200 }),
  timeout: 30000
}).then(r => r.text()).then(t => console.log(t.slice(0,1000)));
```

maria: Go (tiny):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "io/ioutil"
)
func main(){
  body := []byte(`{"model":"open-8b","input":"Summarize quarterly earnings in 3 bullets","max_tokens":1200}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer REDACTED")
  req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID", "0a1b2c3d4e")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, _ := client.Do(req)
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode)
  fmt.Println(string(b)[:1000])
}
```

jay: Perfect. Also need steps for them to collect the debug bundle:
- capture the request headers (full) and the exact timestamp (UTC).
- enable SDK debug env var `RW_DEBUG=1` for one minute and reproduce once.
- curl reproduction (no SDK) to show raw TCP path: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Request-ID: 0a1b2c3d4e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-8b","input":"Summarize quarterly earnings in 3 bullets","max_tokens":1200}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

jay: Then collect the local SDK logs (~~/var/log/redwood-sdk.log), and the system dmesg if present. Compress into tar.gz and upload to support bucket `s3://redwood-support-uploads/2060004321/` with the ticket id in filename.

oliver: On our side, we'll pull traces for X-Request-ID 0a1b2c3d4e and look for slow kernels / retry loops. Also check routing (eu-west-1 -> pod-3) and any fallback model variant.

noah: Quick note: ask customer to include sampling of successful 200s around the same time window so we can compare latency distribution. even 3 samples helps.

support-bot: Playbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/support/debug-bundle-playbook — follow "tiny repro" section and attach `support-ticket-<id>.json` metadata file.

jay: I'll send the repro snippets + instructions to the customer now. tagging @oliver once they upload the tar. thanks all :thumbsup:
